premise_review: Every conclusion depends on an explicit A : AmbientIsotopyExtensionTheory T G. The whole capability record is retained, not manufactured from T.FramedIsotopic e₀ e₁.
The interface preserves Time : Type uD, distinct timeZero/timeOne, isotopyRefl/Symm/Trans, jointly smooth ambient/framed families, both endpoint equations, and ambientFamily timeOne = ambientEnd.

All-time CarriesEmbedding, SupportedAwayFromOldBoundary, SupportedInInterior, FixesOutsideSupport and FixesOldBoundary fields remain explicit inputs; no relation between these arbitrary model-specific predicates is invented.

The interface retains inducedOnSurgery, surgeryEnd and surgery_naturality as well as ambient and surgery identity/reversal/concatenation laws. The record is deliberately kept intact because those operations and equations depend on each other.

The family certificate is a conjunction of the supplied smoothness/endpoint/control fields. Terminal support lemmas rewrite along ambient_family_one; carries_embedding also uses framed_embedding_one. No geometric construction or support estimate is newly proved.

surgery_invariant uses RelativeBoundaryDiffeomorphismTheory.sound G applied to the supplied surgeryEnd. The selected dependency context defines G.Hom as a supplied groupoid and sound as a supplied forgetting map, not a construction from the mere proposition.

invariant_eq additionally requires an arbitrary value : T.Manifold → Invariant and respects : ∀ {X Y}, G.Hom X Y → value X = value Y. This functoriality premise is copied exactly; no universal invariant equality follows without it.

All theorem statements, proof terms, field types, simp attributes, universe variables, implicit p/q/M/e arguments and include A G contexts remain exact. Only explicit namespace/import/module scaffolding differs and is UNREPLAYED.
